N, T = map(int, input().split())
A = list(map(int, input().split()))

horizontal = [0] * N
vertical = [0] * N
diagonal = [0, 0]

for i, a in enumerate(A):
    row = (a - 1) // N
    col = (a - 1) % N
    horizontal[row] += 1
    vertical[col] += 1
    if row == col:
        diagonal[0] += 1
    if row + col == N - 1:
        diagonal[1] += 1
    if horizontal[row] == N or vertical[col] == N or diagonal[0] == N or diagonal[1] == N:
